Original Text (English)

Big landlords used software to collude on rent prices, DC lawsuit says

Russian Translation

Крупные арендодатели использовали ПО для сговора о ценах на аренду, говорится в иске округа Колумбия

Transliteration: Krupniye arendodateli ispol'zovali PO dlya sgovora o tsenakh na arendu, govoritsya v iske okruga Kolumbiya

school Vocabulary Breakdown

menu_book Linguistic Notes

  • Collude Translated as сговор (sgovor). This implies a secret agreement, specifically in a legal or negative context (conspiracy).
  • Software Translated as ПО (PO), which is the standard abbreviation for программное обеспечение (programmnoye obespecheniye).
  • Passive Voice "DC lawsuit says" is translated using a passive construction говорится в иске (literally: "it is said in the lawsuit"). This is standard for Russian news headlines.

breaking_news The News Context

This sentence refers to a major antitrust lawsuit filed by the DC Attorney General against RealPage and 14 major landlords.

The lawsuit alleges that landlords shared private data with RealPage's software, which then used algorithms to artificially inflate rent prices across Washington D.C., acting like a modern "digital cartel."

link Source: DC OAG
